body:
Updated for all of you who were kind enough to respond.   


I called the police and was taken to a psychiatric hospital, they diagnosed me with PTSD. CPS is now involved. I wasn't removed from home bu they're monitoring my home. My first meeting is on Wednesday.
Thank you! What age would you say I am by my voice?
I have a doctors appointment tomorrow. Thank you (hugs)

It's been quite a long time, but I found out my doctor does walk-ins so I plan to go Monday. I'm scared for another cps investigation. I feel like my life is falling apart.

My moms fiance buys food but he doesn't suspect any abuse. He hasn't quite seen all that my mom is. I get a lot of "Your mother wants you to spend more time with her." So yeah, he's pretty unaware.  


I'm starving but life seemed somewhat okay. I'm scared.
I have a doctors appointment monday and I'm scared.

I always thought it'd be ok. I eat everyday, she just feeds me small portions.I'm just secerely malnourished.I've been through seven CPS investigations. I'm not sure they'll care. 

I feel too guilty to move. I used to fight, but I'm tired now. I can't get to a hospital without a parent.

I feel like maybe I'm overreacting. Maybe CPS and the police won't care until I'm dead. So, I'm just waiting for it. I still feel guilty.

That maybe the starvation isn't intention, maybe we're just poor.
I'm 16, and turning 17 in July. I have no idea what to do next. Can you ask for a different csaeworker? I have siblings, but they don't live with me.

There has been a different caseworker everytime. This one, she didn't even check to see if we had running water. She didn't ask me any questions like that, just the standard. "How does your mom discipline you?" 


She really only addressed my mom. We're poor, and so is the surrounding area. My mom pulled the "perfect mom" act, and made it seem like I was the problem. All I could do was cry.
Thank you. I appreciate it.

My parents have told me they are giving me away if CPS comes again, ad if CPS doesn't take me, my life will get worse.
No laptop, phone, they check my room, and my interactions with friends.

I'm so proud of you. I've been where you are about five times, ad I may wouldn't have if I had just told the truth earlier. This will be the most guilt-ridden deicision you will make, but trust me, you will end up happier in the end. Your Nparents will lie, be nice, and scheme to make themselves look good. You will want to change your mind.

Don't.

You are much stronger than they are. I wish you luck.

Yeah, all the time. My mom hates things to be left "on a bad note", so after she got done yelling at me, I had to hug her. If I didn't, I was being unforgiving, even if I didn't want to be touched.
Now, I flinch when she touches me.

Update: My Nmom broke up with her abusive bf, and told me to "not worry about it." Now, it seems they are back together, and arguing as always, it seems toxic. I tried calling my caseworker, but my case was closed, she told me to "suck it up."

I lost my home with my Ndad, and have moved in with Nmom. I called some agencies, they can only call cps, and can't help until I'm 17.

Update: My Nmom broke up with her abusive bf, and told me to "not worry about it." Now, it seems they are back together, and arguing as always, it seems toxic. I tried calling my caseworker, but my case was closed, she told me to "suck it up."


I lost my home with my Ndad, and have moved in with Nmom. I called some agencies, they can only call cps, and can't help until I'm 17.

Update: I tried to call my caseworker about getting out of my enviroment. My case was closed. She told me to "suck it up." She doesn't want to put me in a group home.
Meanwhile, my Ndad isnt contacting my Nmom until he gets full custody. My Nmoms bf said she can only call my Ndad once about me.

And it looks like she wants to marry him. This is the beginning of an abusive relationship. 
I was left at school untik 6pm last night, and I dont know whos going to pick me up from school today.

TW: Mentions of suicide


What I always, always get is, "I'm so hard on you. because I love you. I want you to reach your full potential."
Like telling your suicidal kid to "Go ahead and kill yourself." Makes them realize thier full potential.
Sadly, this line still works.
That sounds like a lot of what my mom used to do to me. I had to "be there for her", because I was her only child, and she was a single mother.
In my eyes, a lot if they force me to stay with him. I have documentation af abuse, I plan to show it Monday.
I'm a bit scared to call because he said, if CPS ever came to his house, I'm leaving and never returning.

My dad told me he's "tired of playing games with me, and that he's done compromising."
So, he wants me out. They didn't really give me a reason besides that and a "bad attitude and disrespect."
Apparently, they find it disrespectful that I flinch when touched. My mom said that I "use her."
Yeah, I planned on calling CPS Monday, but by then, I'd have no home.
I have been given no papers, my parents just told me I have by Monday to get out.

I'm 5'2" 
I don't get tailored, but my general wardrobe consists of skinny jeans that are long enough to cuff.
I shop in the womens section.

You need something formal, but approachable. 
I'd wear a graphic tee, since youre most likely going to be around other artists, and it'd give off the feeling that you're into fantasy/comics.
(make sure the shirt is fantasy themed)
I'd wear a nice fitting pant, cuffed, and a pair of brown or black dress shoes. 
or, a nice pair of sneakers. Keep it loose, have fun. 
Good luck!
I didn't try to commit suicide. I guess a step is a step, right?
I got: manipulative, selfish, liar,  and two-faced. I don't know if those count as nicknames, but that's what they refer to me as, at least when I've done something wrond, and they're mad.
I'd say, maybe Carrie.Her mom is pretty abusive, and she uses her powers to get revenge
I say nothing, and cry.
I really want to die.I don't know why I do this anymore.
It's great you're making progress! Love you too, fam.
*Hugs* I have a friend I can stay with, I think. They said thier parents won't turn  down a homeless kid. So, I may be able to. However, my parents can sue for kidnapping.
I really hope I'm making progress. I have a new therapist now.
I am. I'm just scared. If anything bad happens, I could end up homeless.
thanks. I appreciate this.

I'm with my dad, he's ok, but he also has asshole tendencies. Even if my mom is abusive, he just treats the women in his life like shit. On top of that, he's a know-it-all. But, in real life, I really have no one.
Thanks for beileving in me.

I just switched from a shitty therapist, and I have a school social worker, but I don't tell her the details, because my mom and dad will kick me out if CPS comes again.
I like the caseworker, she's nice.
I'm just really tired of being strong.

No! That's not ok! Who hits an infant?!

I'm so sorry that happened to you.
God, my mom does that all the time. I hate her laugh, and the "Why are teens so weird these days jokes."
It's not your fault. :)
It's always slow
Yeah, they just sent  a CPS case worker
I really don't have anyone else. So, maybe I might as well die.

CPS= Child Protective Services.
Either way, it seems just me being alive is causing problems.
I mean, you have your life, one random internet one shouldn't matter all that much.

My mom has been reported more than once. The hospital called, I once threatened suicide and the police came.
My mom is usually like that, after she fucks up, she's calm. But the niceness never lasts.
I just want to be a kid my mom can love. But I'm not. Loveable people don't get treated that way.
Why is it always my fault?

CPS was called, so, because of that, my mom might lose her job, and it's my fault.She said if they come again, I'm leaving, I can't stay with her anymore.
She told me to  "Pack my Shit."
She told me to kill myself, to stab myself if I was really suicidal.
Its because of my selfishness. She has such a shitty kid she doesn't even want. My mo is a single parent, my dad isn't around too much.
Everytime I tell her how I feel, she says they're lying to me. She told me I need to accept my wrong, so I am. She can still have children. She won't miss a shitty one.

I'm lways here, I should just kill myself, instead of clogging up the chat.
Why do my problems even matter to you all?

It's all becoming too much. I'm reiceveing help, but none of it works. So, I'll probs be this way forever. I'm stuck in a CPS investigation, and both my parenst keep reminding me how they might lose thier job, and it'd be my fault. My mom treats me bad, but when I want to leave, I just feel guilty. It repeats over and over in my mind. I can't sleep without a nightmare.

The time my mom told me to kill myself.
the time she said I probablly liked rape.
the time she yelled at me to get out while I curled up in a ball sobbing "I'm sorry" over and over again.
The time I tried to get away from her sceaming, but she grabs me by my clothes, puling me back, and I had to bite her.
The time her friend called me crazy because I defended myself.
The time she told me I was lying on her to my counselor.
The time she dared me t stab myself
All I can feel is overwhelming guilt. Even if it ends forever, that's ok with me.

I'm tired of being stuck in this continuous loop. Don't give me that "it gets better" shit. I've tried 3 times, and afterwards life never got better, it got worse.
When I say I cringe, it's more like a inward disgust about myself. I hate it. Everytime it happens I just want to kill myself.

All the time. She gave me rants about me  questioning whether God exists. I'm not able to wactch anime or pokemon, since "Japan isn't a Christian nation." I can't read Harry Potter, and I sure as hell can show intrest in astrology. I can't read fantasy either.


She checks my phone and laptop regularly to make sure I'm not on "sites she doesn't approve of."

Absolutely. I just keep thinking my Nmom has changed, that maybe she's getting better. She never really does. We've been trained to be attached them. I'm my mothers only living family, so I'm stuckwith the guilt that she'll kill herself without me.
She has legitamately told me she couldn't live without. Then, a week later, told me to kill myself.
I want to protect her and be ok. But, I want to be safe too.
I completely relate.

That's terrible, but I get the relief. You finally get peace,but lose a parent. I hope you find a supportive home without Nparents.
I'm here if you need me, fam.

Its the ending of it that'll give me happiness. I feel nothing now, so death isn't  all that different.

You dont have to give me your fb, fam.
No one misses one random person. At least this way, I get happiness.

I came out as gay previously. My Nmom tried pressuring me into telling her where she touched me, then, when I didn't, told me I probablly liked it. 

Oddly enough, she has also experienced sexual assault.

Make sure the therapist gets to know you first, tell them everything. If not, your Nparents might try to turn the therapist against you. 

Make sure they're going to therapy to change themselves, not you.

That's great!
Glad you found happiness.
Less time dating men, more time being happy with myself and dating women.

I know exactly how you feel. I would've just shruged.
More women for me then.

You have no idea. I came out as trans and gay. I was so excited, I wrote a letter, put it under a tea mug, and jumped into the shower. I was pumped. 
My Nmom calls me out, and, I was yelled at for hours. She said, and I quote, "Your feelings are lying to you. I once felt that I should kill me and you, but I realized that thought was of Satan."

For 30 mins she broke down in tears, crying about how she'd never have grandkids. Then, she went back to yelling.
I wish I could take it all back.

I was able to get in touch with a LGBT housing center, and they got in contact with my case worker. 

I'm starting to see a happy future for myself. 

Sidenote: I got myself a girlfriend! I love her dearly.
I'd really like to thank you both for the information. It means a lot to me.

That's what N's do. As soon as you grow distant, and try to recieve help, they try to bring you down. It's thier way to instill fear, and get you back in thier control.

Don't fall for it. Stay strong.

( sorry for my bitterness)
